# Architecture Knowledge Graph

> A structured and governed knowledge graph for data, information and enterprise architecture. All content is draft (status proposed) unless stated otherwise; check `status` and `authority` before relying on it.

## Machine-readable

- [Graph (published objects and typed relationships)](api/graph.json)
